Create the missing OPPOSITE-LEG HALF of the approved Archive Knight walk cycle as exactly FOUR complete full-body poses in a clean 2 columns x 2 rows source sheet. References 1 and 2 are absolute Archive Knight identity authorities. Reference 3 shows the accepted first half-cycle's exact body scale, screen-right three-quarter camera, lighting, armor rendering, and integrated blade treatment. Reference 4 supplies only canonical walking mechanics.

Preserve exactly: faceless ivory crested helm; cyan visor slit; enormous open broken-archive-arch LEFT pauldron with dark-indigo center and cyan inner seam; small RIGHT shoulder plate; violet sternum core; porcelain plates; deep-plum joints; short rigid split tabards; heavy boots; one cyan-edged archive blade attached along the RIGHT forearm at constant length. Never mirror, swap, omit, duplicate or redesign asymmetrical features.

The four poses are the right-leg-leading mirror phase in motion, without mirroring the costume: 1 opposite-foot contact, 2 down position, 3 passing position, 4 up position. Natural arm counter-swing, same height and baseline, screen-right travel, measured armored walk. Every complete figure fits inside one quarter with generous clearance.

PROJECT MANNEQUIN STYLE LOCK: controlled dark contours, broad two-to-four-step cel shading, clean graphic highlights, fighting-game anatomy, polished anime finish. Perfectly uniform pure white background. No grid, text, labels, border, floor, shadows, scenery, extra figures, extra limbs, detached/second blade, shield, cape, long robe, floating parts, cropped crest/blade/feet, overlap, photorealism, PBR, rust, grime, microtexture, or painterly blur.
